scope.purpose: test whether the stable proper residual correlation near causal lag 45 produces a useful sparse long-memory linear correction before adding nonlinear spline branches
not_claimed: physical attribution to the PA rather than the feedback path

hypothesis.model: y_hat_fir[n] = y_hat_gmp[n] + sum_{d in D} b_d * x[n-d]
hypothesis.regression_target: fit b so that sum_d b_d*x[n-d] approximates e[n]
hypothesis.interpretation: a reproducible gain is evidence that the selected causal GMP omits a cheap proper-complex long-memory component; it does not identify whether the component belongs to the PA or measurement path
hypothesis.phase_equivariance: preserved because rotating x rotates the proper complex FIR correction by the same phase
hypothesis.negative_lag_policy: negative residual-correlation lags are future-input diagnostics and are forbidden as deployable model features

discovery_evidence.usage_status: both train OOF and validation residual reports were inspected while choosing this family and supports; neither is an independent confirmation set

previous_nested_ablation.result: short conjugate supports failed the preregistered 0.1 dB OOF threshold; selected no_correction

correction_fit.frame_state_policy: zero/reset delayed-input state at every explicit frame
correction_fit.oof_protocol: for each leave-one-explicit-frame-out fold, refit the frozen GMP recipe on fit frames, compute fit-frame residuals, fit proper complex FIR coefficients only on those residuals, and predict the held frame
correction_fit.full_train_protocol: use the integrity-verified full-train frozen GMP, fit proper complex FIR coefficients on full-train residuals, then report the already-viewed validation split descriptively
correction_fit.test_protocol: forbidden in this audit; a separate frozen release decision and preferably a new capture are required

operation_count_convention.input_state: extend the selected GMP raw complex input history from delay 29 to the candidate maximum delay; existing power-stream histories and per-sample raw delay-line writes are reused
operation_count_convention.common_scoring_support: all candidates fit within the already frozen 49-sample common warmup, so no candidate receives a shorter scoring interval

selection_rule.candidate_score: min(full_record_gain_db, common_interior_gain_db) relative to no_correction; larger is better
selection_rule.complexity_tie_break: among eligible candidates within 0.02 dB of the best candidate_score, choose the fewest proper FIR taps, then the smallest maximum delay
selection_rule.fallback: select no_correction if no proper FIR support is eligible

required_metrics: post-fit proper and pseudo residual correlations
reporting.validation_label: already-viewed descriptive validation, never independent confirmation
reporting.test_metrics: must not be read or emitted

follow_up_gate.if_internal_audit_passes: retain the selected proper FIR as the linear-memory ablation and preregister whether replacing its constant gain with a phase-equivariant spline/CPWL nonlinearity adds enough OOF gain per operation
follow_up_gate.if_internal_audit_fails: do not add nonlinear spline branches at these discovered long delays without separate nonlinear residual evidence; preregister the standalone spline/CPWL plus short-FIR family as a different inductive-bias experiment
follow_up_gate.dpa_policy: do not tune a separate DPA long-lag support from already-viewed DPA residuals; any transfer check must use the APA-frozen support and be labelled non-independent
